answers.core: This must be core to Godot Engine because it requires a lot of low-level hooks to do it right, and other extensions need to be able to build on these features.
answers.workaround: For the general case, no. It would take many thousands of lines of script. For a more narrow case, it could be done with less, but the goal here is to implement a system that is extendable and allows animating many properties.

title: Implement KHR_animation_pointer in GLTF for animating custom properties
